integrity.claim_scope: Exact equilibrium positivity for the printed delayed Ivlev model and the Section 4.1 parameter vector.
integrity.numerical_role: Floating-point values are used only to display exact logarithmic thresholds and the sign of the printed equilibrium formula at tau=250; they are not substitutes for the symbolic argument.
integrity.proof_basis: Direct elimination in the two equilibrium equations, monotonicity of the printed coexistence coordinate, and exact substitution of the source parameters.

scientific_limitations: The correction is restricted to the coexistence-existence and associated stability-interval statements for the Section 4.1 parameter vector.
The Hopf frequencies, periodic-orbit computations, and the separate chaotic parameter set in Section 4.2 were not recomputed.
No claim is made about whether plotted numerical continuation software internally enforced positivity after the transcritical collision.
title: Corrected coexistence threshold in the Liu–Zhang delayed Ivlev example
